validation_scope: One-step-ahead aggregate hourly traffic counts only. Lag at t-1 is observed; not an open-loop multi-hour forecast. Synthetic vehicle paths and capacity interventions are not empirically validated.

protocol.features: hour one-hot, weekday one-hot, observed previous-hour volume
protocol.fit: ridge normal equations, L2=1, train only
protocol.interval: absolute residual quantile on separate calibration period; no time-series coverage guarantee

limitations: Single traffic counter, no fleet trajectories or measured travel-time validation.
Chronological split is small and location specific.
Temporal dependence and drift can invalidate nominal conformal coverage.
Corridor capacity is illustrative; no causal claim about changing infrastructure.
